## Hotels and prices for 2027

Prices are in US dollars per person for the programme, including 6 nights, breakfast and the listed services. SGL means single occupancy, DBL double occupancy and TRP triple occupancy.

| Category and hotel | Room | SGL | DBL | TRP |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 3*: B&B Copacabana | Superior | 3488 | 2039 | 1684 |
| 4*: Arena Leme | Standard | 4148 | 2241 | 2219 |
| 5*: Miramar by Windsor | Standard | 4830 | 2624 | 2266 |

The specific hotel or an equivalent alternative and room availability are confirmed at the time of booking. Excursions to Vidigal and Petrópolis are not included in this programme.
